query: My account got locked. How long until I can try again?
context:
# Account and Security
## Signing in
You can sign in to ShopNest with a one-time password (OTP) sent to your mobile number, or with your e-mail address and password. We recommend turning on 2-step verification under My Account > Security, so that a new device needs both your password and an OTP.

Each mobile number can be linked to only one ShopNest account.

## Locked accounts
After 5 failed sign-in attempts, your account is locked for 30 minutes to protect it. You can wait 30 minutes and try again, or reset your password straight away using the "Forgot password" link, which sends a reset link to your registered e-mail address. The reset link is valid for 24 hours.

## Changing your mobile number
To change the mobile number on your account, go to My Account > Profile > Mobile number. We send an OTP to both your old and your new number. If you no longer have access to the old number, choose "I don't have my old number" and we will verify you through a link sent to your registered e-mail address, valid for 24 hours.

# Account and Security
## Staying safe
Important: ShopNest will never ask for your OTP, password, CVV, UPI PIN or full card number over phone, e-mail, SMS or chat. Our agents will never ask you to install a screen-sharing or remote-access app. If someone asks for these details claiming to be from ShopNest, do not share them and report it to security@shopnest.example.

Beware of fake ShopNest pages and messages offering prizes, refunds or jobs in exchange for a payment or your bank details. ShopNest never asks you to pay money to receive a refund.

## Unauthorised activity
If you see an order you did not place, or a change you did not make, report it within 24 hours through chat or by calling 1800-202-6378. We freeze the account within 1 hour of your report and complete the investigation within 7 business days. Any amount charged for a confirmed unauthorised order is refunded in full.

You can sign out of all devices at any time from My Account > Security > Sign out everywhere.

# Account and Security
## Deleting your account
You can delete your account from My Account > Privacy > Delete account. Deletion is completed within 30 days of your request. Before you delete it:

- All orders must be delivered and all returns and refunds completed.
- Your NestCoins are forfeited and cannot be restored.
- Your ShopNest Wallet balance is refunded to your bank account.
- Order and invoice records are kept for 8 years, as required by tax law, even after deletion.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Refunds
## When a refund is initiated
For returns, the refund is initiated after the returned item passes our quality check, which happens within 2 business days of the item reaching our warehouse. For prepaid orders that you cancel before they are shipped, the refund is initiated immediately. For damaged, defective or wrong items, the refund is initiated as soon as the pickup is completed.

You will receive an SMS and e-mail with the refund amount and a refund reference number. For card and net banking refunds this reference is the ARN (Acquirer Reference Number), which your bank can use to trace the credit.

## Refund timelines by payment method
Once a refund is initiated, the time it takes to reach you depends on how you paid:

| Payment method | Refund timeline after initiation |
|---|---|
| UPI | 1–3 business days |
| Net banking | 3–5 business days |
| Credit or debit card | 5–7 business days |
| Card EMI | 7–10 business days |
| International card | 7–14 business days |
| ShopNest Wallet | within 2 hours |
| Gift card | within 24 hours, back to the same gift card |
| Cash on Delivery | ShopNest Wallet within 2 hours, or bank account via NEFT in 5–7 business days |

# Cash on Delivery and EMI
## EMI on cancellations and returns
If you cancel or return an order paid by card EMI, the refund goes back to your card and your bank cancels the EMI plan. Card EMI refunds take 7–10 business days after the refund is initiated. Interest already charged by your bank for the months that have passed, and any processing fee, are governed by your bank's policy and are not refunded by ShopNest.

EMI is not available on gift card purchases or international orders.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

## Escalation levels (continued)
1. **Level 1, Customer Support:** chat, phone or e-mail. Most issues are resolved here.
2. **Level 2, Customer Care Manager:** if your issue is not resolved within 48 hours, ask the agent to escalate it, or tap "Escalate" on your ticket. A Customer Care Manager responds within 1 business day and aims to resolve the issue within 3 business days.
3. **Level 3, Grievance Officer:** if you are still not satisfied, write to grievance@shopnest.example with your ticket number. The Grievance Officer acknowledges your complaint within 48 hours and resolves it within 30 days, as required by the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.

For prepaid orders cancelled before dispatch, the refund is initiated immediately. Refunds to UPI take 1–3 business days, net banking 3–5 business days and credit or debit cards 5–7 business days. Refunds to the ShopNest Wallet arrive within 2 hours. The shipping fee is refunded in full when an order is cancelled before dispatch.

If you cancel an order before dispatch, any single-use coupon used on the order is restored to your account, provided the coupon has not expired. Bank offer discounts are not restored; you can use the offer again only if it is still running.

The delivery address can be changed before the order is shipped, but only to another address with the same pincode. To deliver to a different pincode, cancel the order and place a new one. The phone number for delivery can be changed until the order is out for delivery.

# Payment Methods
## Accepted payment methods
ShopNest accepts the following payment methods on orders delivered within India:

- UPI, using any UPI app, a UPI ID or a QR code
- Credit and debit cards: Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, American Express and Diners Club
- Net banking from more than 50 banks
- ShopNest Wallet balance
- ShopNest gift cards
- NestCoins (1 NestCoin = ₹1)
- EMI on credit cards, select debit cards and cardless EMI
- Cash on Delivery (COD)

All prices are in Indian rupees (INR) and include GST.

## UPI
UPI payments are confirmed instantly. The maximum amount per UPI transaction is set by your bank, usually ₹1,00,000. ShopNest Plus membership can be renewed automatically using UPI AutoPay.

## Cards
Saved cards are stored as secure tokens in line with RBI card-tokenisation rules. ShopNest never stores your full card number or your CVV. Every card payment is authenticated with an OTP or your bank's 3D Secure page. International cards are accepted, and are charged in Indian rupees; your bank may add a foreign-exchange fee.

# Payment Methods
## Combining payment methods
You can split a payment between ShopNest Wallet balance, gift cards and NestCoins, and one other payment method such as UPI or a card. You cannot split a payment between two cards or between a card and UPI.

## Failed payments
If money was debited but your order was not confirmed, the amount is reversed automatically. UPI debits are reversed within 48 hours. Card and net banking debits are reversed within 5–7 business days, depending on your bank. You do not need to contact us; you can place the order again at any time.

If a payment fails repeatedly, try another method or clear your browser cache. Do not share screenshots of card details with anyone claiming to help with a failed payment.

## Invoices
A GST invoice is generated for every order when it ships. Download it from My Orders > Order details > Download invoice. Business customers who need GST input tax credit must add their GSTIN before placing the order; see the ShopNest Business policy.

# Payment Methods
## Payment security
Important: ShopNest will never ask for your OTP, password, CVV, UPI PIN or full card number over phone, e-mail, SMS or chat. If someone asks for these details claiming to be from ShopNest, do not share them and report it to security@shopnest.example.

## Need more help?
For more information about Cash on Delivery and EMI, see the COD and EMI policy. For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Gift Cards

ShopNest e-gift cards are available in any amount from ₹500 to ₹50,000, in multiples of ₹100. The gift card is sent by e-mail or SMS to the recipient within 15 minutes of payment, or on a date you choose when you schedule delivery.

Gift cards can be paid for with UPI, cards or net banking. They cannot be bought with another gift card, NestCoins, ShopNest Wallet balance, Cash on Delivery or EMI. Gift card purchases do not earn NestCoins.

## Validity
Each gift card is valid for 12 months from the date it is issued. The validity cannot be extended. Any balance left after the expiry date is lost, so check your balance under My Account > Gift Cards.

## Using gift cards
You can use up to 5 gift cards on a single order. Gift cards can be combined with one other payment method, such as UPI or a card, to pay the remaining amount. If the order costs less than the gift card balance, the rest stays on the card for future orders.

Gift cards can be used on any product sold on ShopNest, but not to buy other gift cards.

# Gift Cards
## Refunds on orders paid with gift cards
If you cancel or return an order that you paid with a gift card, the amount is credited back to the same gift card within 24 hours. If the gift card has already expired, the amount is added to your ShopNest Wallet instead, where it never expires.

## Gift cards are non-refundable
Gift cards cannot be returned, refunded or exchanged for cash, except where required by law.

## Lost or stolen gift cards
Treat your gift card code like cash. Once a gift card has been redeemed, it cannot be blocked or replaced. If the code has not been redeemed yet, the person who bought it can contact support with the order ID; we will block the card and reissue it once.

## Corporate gift cards
Companies buying gift cards in bulk for employees or customers can get volume discounts through ShopNest Business; see the ShopNest Business policy.

Beware of fake ShopNest pages and messages offering prizes, refunds or jobs in exchange for a payment or your bank details. ShopNest never asks you to pay money to receive a refund.

query: How much does same-day delivery cost?
context:
# Express Delivery
## Next-day delivery
Next-day delivery is available in 25 cities, including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Kochi, Lucknow and Indore. Place your order by 12 noon to receive it the next day.

Next-day delivery costs ₹99 per order. It is free for ShopNest Plus members.

## Same-day delivery
Same-day delivery is available in 6 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune. Place your order by 10 AM to receive it the same evening, by 9 PM.

Same-day delivery costs ₹149 per order. ShopNest Plus members pay ₹49 for same-day delivery.

In these 6 cities, express deliveries also run on Sundays. In the other next-day cities, an order placed on Saturday is delivered on Monday.

## Eligible items
Express delivery is available only on items marked "Express eligible" on the product page. Furniture, large appliances and orders shipping outside India cannot be sent by express. If your cart has both eligible and non-eligible items, the order is split and only the eligible items are sent by express.

# Express Delivery
## Eligible items (continued)
Cash on Delivery is available on express orders up to ₹10,000. Express orders above ₹10,000 must be prepaid.

## If we miss the express promise
If an express order arrives later than promised, the express fee is refunded automatically to your ShopNest Wallet within 48 hours. You do not need to contact us. The express fee is not refunded if the delay was caused by an incorrect address or because nobody was available to receive the package.

## Cancelling an express order
Express orders can be cancelled free of charge before they are shipped, like any other order. Express orders are often dispatched within an hour, so the cancellation window can be very short. If an express order is cancelled before dispatch, the express fee is refunded along with the order amount.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Domestic Shipping
## Delayed or lost shipments
If your order has not arrived within 3 business days after the promised delivery date, contact support. We investigate delayed shipments within 48 hours. If a shipment is confirmed lost in transit, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund, including any shipping fee.

## Faster options
Need it sooner? Express next-day and same-day delivery are available in selected cities. See the Express Delivery policy for cities, cut-off times and fees.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Domestic Shipping
## Where we deliver
ShopNest delivers to more than 19,000 pincodes across India. Enter your pincode on any product page to see whether the item can be delivered to you and the expected delivery date.

## Delivery times
Standard delivery takes 2–4 business days in metro cities and 3–7 business days in other cities and towns. Deliveries to remote areas, including Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, the North-Eastern states, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands and Lakshadweep, can take an additional 2–4 business days.

Orders placed before 2 PM on a business day are dispatched the same day. Orders placed after 2 PM, or on Sundays and public holidays, are dispatched on the next business day.

Large items such as furniture and large appliances are delivered free of charge by our large-item partner within 5–10 business days. Our partner will call you to schedule a delivery slot.

## Shipping charges
Standard shipping is free on orders of ₹499 and above, calculated after discounts. Orders below ₹499 have a shipping fee of ₹49. ShopNest Plus members get free standard shipping on every order, with no minimum order value.

# Price Match and Price Drop Protection
## How to request a price match
Before buying, start a chat with ShopNest support and share a link or screenshot of the competitor's offer. If it qualifies, we give you a single-use coupon for the difference, valid for 24 hours.

If you have already bought the item, you can request a price match within 48 hours of your order. The difference is credited to your ShopNest Wallet within 24 hours of approval.

## Limits
The maximum price-match difference is ₹10,000 per item. Each customer can make up to 3 price-match requests per calendar month. ShopNest may refuse a price match if the competitor's stock is very limited or the price appears to be an error.

## Sales
Neither Price Drop Protection nor Competitor Price Match applies to orders placed during a Big Nest Sale.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# International Shipping
## Countries we ship to
Outside India, ShopNest ships to 7 countries: the United Arab Emirates, Singapore, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Australia and Nepal. We do not currently ship to any other country. Look for the "Ships internationally" label on the product page.

## Shipping fees and delivery times
International shipping is charged per order, for parcels up to 5 kg:

| Destination | Shipping fee | Delivery time |
|---|---|---|
| Nepal | ₹599 | 5–8 business days |
| UAE, Singapore | ₹1,499 | 7–14 business days |
| UK, USA, Canada, Australia | ₹2,499 | 7–14 business days |

Parcels heavier than 5 kg are charged ₹400 for each additional kg. International orders are limited to ₹2,00,000 per order.

## Customs duties and taxes
International orders are shipped duties unpaid. Any customs duties, import taxes and clearance charges are set by the destination country and are paid by the recipient at delivery. ShopNest cannot estimate or refund these charges.

# Price Match and Price Drop Protection
## Price Drop Protection
If the price of an item you bought drops on ShopNest within 7 days of your order, we refund the difference to your ShopNest Wallet. The lower price must be for the same item, the same variant (size, colour or storage) and the same seller. Go to My Orders, select the item and tap "Price dropped?". The difference is credited within 24 hours of approval.

Price Drop Protection can be claimed once per item. It does not cover price differences caused by coupons, bank offers, NestCoins or lightning deals.

## Competitor Price Match
ShopNest matches the price of authorised Indian retailers on electronics and home appliances. To qualify, the competitor's offer must be:

- For the same brand, model, colour and storage or capacity
- New and in stock, sold by the retailer itself on its own website or in its own store
- A regular price that anyone can buy at, including the competitor's delivery charges

We do not match:

- Prices from third-party sellers on marketplaces
- Open-box, refurbished or used items
- Bundles, cashback, bank offers or exchange offers
- Flash sales and membership-only prices
- Apparel, footwear and furniture

# ShopNest Business: Bulk and B2B Orders
## Payment and credit terms
Business orders can be paid by NEFT, RTGS, corporate card or UPI. Verified businesses can apply for net-30 credit terms after 3 successful orders, with a credit limit of up to ₹5,00,000.

## Delivery
Bulk orders are delivered within 7–12 business days. Delivery to several office locations is available for ₹999 per additional address.

## Cancellation
A confirmed bulk order can be cancelled free of charge within 24 hours of confirmation. After 24 hours, a cancellation fee of 5% of the order value applies if the order has not shipped. Bulk orders cannot be cancelled once they have shipped.

## Returns on bulk orders
Change-of-mind returns are not accepted on bulk orders. Damaged, defective, missing or wrong items in a bulk order must be reported within 7 days of delivery, instead of the 48 hours that applies to regular orders, because large deliveries take longer to inspect. We replace or refund the affected units only.

# Price Match and Price Drop Protection
## How to request a price match
Before buying, start a chat with ShopNest support and share a link or screenshot of the competitor's offer. If it qualifies, we give you a single-use coupon for the difference, valid for 24 hours.

If you have already bought the item, you can request a price match within 48 hours of your order. The difference is credited to your ShopNest Wallet within 24 hours of approval.

## Limits
The maximum price-match difference is ₹10,000 per item. Each customer can make up to 3 price-match requests per calendar month. ShopNest may refuse a price match if the competitor's stock is very limited or the price appears to be an error.

## Sales
Neither Price Drop Protection nor Competitor Price Match applies to orders placed during a Big Nest Sale.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Big Nest Sale: Terms and Conditions
## Lightning deals
Lightning deals are available in limited quantities for a limited time. You can buy at most 2 units of each lightning deal. The deal price applies only while the deal timer is running and stock lasts; adding an item to your cart does not reserve it.

## Returns during the sale
Our standard return windows apply to sale purchases: 30 days from delivery for most items and 10 days for electronics. Items marked "Final Sale" cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged, defective or wrong.

## Price match during the sale
Neither Price Drop Protection nor Competitor Price Match applies to orders placed during a Big Nest Sale.

## Delivery during the sale
Because of high order volumes, deliveries may take 2–3 business days longer than usual during the sale. Express delivery slots are limited and may sell out.

## NestCoins during the sale
During the sale, all customers earn 2 NestCoins for every ₹100 spent, and ShopNest Plus members earn 3 NestCoins for every ₹100.

# Big Nest Sale: Terms and Conditions
## Sale dates
The Big Nest Sale runs twice a year. The Diwali edition runs from 16 to 22 October 2026, and the New Year edition from 26 to 31 December 2026. ShopNest Plus members get early access 24 hours before the sale opens to everyone.

## Bank offer
During the sale, you get a 10% instant discount, up to ₹1,500, when you pay with a partner bank's credit card or credit card EMI on orders of ₹5,000 or more. Each card can use the offer at most 2 times during a sale. The bank offer does not apply to UPI, debit cards, net banking, Cash on Delivery or gift card purchases.

If you return part of an order that used the bank offer and the value of the items you keep falls below ₹5,000, the bank discount is recovered from your refund. If you cancel or return the whole order, you are refunded the amount you actually paid.

# Big Nest Sale: Terms and Conditions
## Fair use
ShopNest may cancel orders that appear to be placed for resale, such as several orders of the same deal to the same address. If an order is cancelled for this reason, you receive a full refund.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. Happy shopping! ShopNest reserves the right to modify these terms at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Price Match and Price Drop Protection
## Price Drop Protection
If the price of an item you bought drops on ShopNest within 7 days of your order, we refund the difference to your ShopNest Wallet. The lower price must be for the same item, the same variant (size, colour or storage) and the same seller. Go to My Orders, select the item and tap "Price dropped?". The difference is credited within 24 hours of approval.

Price Drop Protection can be claimed once per item. It does not cover price differences caused by coupons, bank offers, NestCoins or lightning deals.

## Competitor Price Match
ShopNest matches the price of authorised Indian retailers on electronics and home appliances. To qualify, the competitor's offer must be:

- For the same brand, model, colour and storage or capacity
- New and in stock, sold by the retailer itself on its own website or in its own store
- A regular price that anyone can buy at, including the competitor's delivery charges

We do not match:

- Prices from third-party sellers on marketplaces
- Open-box, refurbished or used items
- Bundles, cashback, bank offers or exchange offers
- Flash sales and membership-only prices
- Apparel, footwear and furniture

# Returns Policy
## Items that cannot be returned
The following items are non-returnable unless they arrive damaged, defective or wrong:

- Innerwear, lingerie, swimwear and socks
- Personalised or engraved products
- Gift cards
- Software, games and digital downloads once activated
- In-ear earphones and earbuds once the hygiene seal is opened
- Mattresses and pillows once the vacuum seal is broken
- Items marked "Final Sale" during a Big Nest Sale

## How to start a return
Go to My Orders, select the item and tap Return. Choose a reason and a pickup slot. Pickup is usually scheduled within 2 business days. Keep the item packed and ready, and hand it over only to the ShopNest courier partner, who will share a pickup OTP.

You can return some items from an order and keep the rest. Each item is handled as a separate return request.

# NestCoins and ShopNest Plus
## NestCoins on returns and cancellations
If you return or cancel an item, the NestCoins you would have earned on it are cancelled. NestCoins you used to pay for it are returned to your balance with their original expiry date; if they would expire within 30 days, we extend them by 30 days.

## ShopNest Plus membership
ShopNest Plus costs ₹999 per year or ₹129 per month. Members get:

- Free standard shipping on every order, with no minimum order value
- Free next-day express delivery, and same-day delivery for ₹49
- Free return pickup, with no ₹79 reverse-pickup fee on change-of-mind returns
- 2 NestCoins for every ₹100 spent, instead of 1
- Early access to the Big Nest Sale, 24 hours before everyone else

## Cancelling Plus
You can cancel ShopNest Plus at any time from My Account > Membership. The annual plan is refunded in full if you cancel within 14 days and have not used any Plus benefit. Otherwise your benefits continue until the end of the paid period, and there is no partial refund. Monthly plans can be cancelled before the next renewal date.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this programme at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Payment Methods
## Accepted payment methods
ShopNest accepts the following payment methods on orders delivered within India:

- UPI, using any UPI app, a UPI ID or a QR code
- Credit and debit cards: Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, American Express and Diners Club
- Net banking from more than 50 banks
- ShopNest Wallet balance
- ShopNest gift cards
- NestCoins (1 NestCoin = ₹1)
- EMI on credit cards, select debit cards and cardless EMI
- Cash on Delivery (COD)

All prices are in Indian rupees (INR) and include GST.

## UPI
UPI payments are confirmed instantly. The maximum amount per UPI transaction is set by your bank, usually ₹1,00,000. ShopNest Plus membership can be renewed automatically using UPI AutoPay.

## Cards
Saved cards are stored as secure tokens in line with RBI card-tokenisation rules. ShopNest never stores your full card number or your CVV. Every card payment is authenticated with an OTP or your bank's 3D Secure page. International cards are accepted, and are charged in Indian rupees; your bank may add a foreign-exchange fee.

## Bulk pricing

| ₹10,00,000 and above | 7% |

# Privacy Policy

- Your name, mobile number, e-mail address and delivery addresses
- Your order history, returns and support conversations
- Payment information as secure tokens; we never store your full card number or CVV
- Device and usage information, such as app version, IP address and pages viewed
- Cookies, as described below

## How we use it
We use your data to process and deliver orders, handle returns and refunds, provide customer support, prevent fraud, and personalise product recommendations. You can turn off personalised recommendations under My Account > Privacy. We send marketing messages only if you opt in, and you can opt out at any time from any message or from My Account > Notifications.

## Who we share it with

- Delivery and logistics partners, to deliver and pick up orders
- Payment processors and banks, to process payments and refunds
- Installation partners, to install products you bought
- Lending partners, only if you choose EMI or cardless EMI

ShopNest never sells your personal data.

Our agents will never ask you to install a screen-sharing or remote-access app. If someone asks for these details claiming to be from ShopNest, do not share them and report it to security@shopnest.example.

Beware of fake ShopNest pages and messages offering prizes, refunds or jobs in exchange for a payment or your bank details. ShopNest never asks you to pay money to receive a refund.

## Unauthorised activity
If you see an order you did not place, or a change you did not make, report it within 24 hours through chat or by calling 1800-202-6378. We freeze the account within 1 hour of your report and complete the investigation within 7 business days. Any amount charged for a confirmed unauthorised order is refunded in full.

A confirmed bulk order can be cancelled free of charge within 24 hours of confirmation. After 24 hours, a cancellation fee of 5% of the order value applies if the order has not shipped. Bulk orders cannot be cancelled once they have shipped.

Change-of-mind returns are not accepted on bulk orders. Damaged, defective, missing or wrong items in a bulk order must be reported within 7 days of delivery, instead of the 48 hours that applies to regular orders, because large deliveries take longer to inspect. - Hips: measure around the fullest part of your hips.

# Cash on Delivery and EMI
## Cash on Delivery (COD)
Cash on Delivery is available on orders up to ₹50,000 delivered within India. A COD handling fee of ₹40 is added to each COD order. You can pay the delivery agent in cash or by scanning the agent's UPI QR code at the doorstep. Please keep the exact amount ready where possible.

Cash on Delivery is not available for:

- Orders above ₹50,000
- Gift card purchases
- International orders
- Express orders above ₹10,000

If 3 Cash on Delivery orders are refused at the doorstep within 6 months, COD may be disabled for your account. You can still pay online.

The ₹40 COD handling fee is not refunded on returns or refusals, except when the item was damaged, defective or wrong.

## Refunds for COD orders
For COD orders, refunds go either to your ShopNest Wallet, credited within 2 hours, or to your bank account by NEFT within 5–7 business days after you add your account number and IFSC. COD refunds cannot be paid out in cash.

# Returns Policy
## Items that cannot be returned
The following items are non-returnable unless they arrive damaged, defective or wrong:

- Innerwear, lingerie, swimwear and socks
- Personalised or engraved products
- Gift cards
- Software, games and digital downloads once activated
- In-ear earphones and earbuds once the hygiene seal is opened
- Mattresses and pillows once the vacuum seal is broken
- Items marked "Final Sale" during a Big Nest Sale

## How to start a return
Go to My Orders, select the item and tap Return. Choose a reason and a pickup slot. Pickup is usually scheduled within 2 business days. Keep the item packed and ready, and hand it over only to the ShopNest courier partner, who will share a pickup OTP.

You can return some items from an order and keep the rest. Each item is handled as a separate return request.

# Returns Policy
## Quality check and refund (continued)
If an item fails the quality check (for example it is used, damaged by the customer or missing accessories), it is shipped back to you at no cost and no refund is issued.

## Gifts
If you received an item as a gift, you can return it within the same window. The refund is issued to your ShopNest Wallet instead of the buyer's payment method, and the buyer is not notified.

For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Returns Policy
## Return pickup fees
Return pickup is free when an item is damaged, defective or wrong. For change-of-mind returns (for example "no longer needed" or "found a better price"), a reverse-pickup fee of ₹79 is deducted from your refund. ShopNest Plus members never pay the reverse-pickup fee. Size and fit issues on apparel and footwear are best handled as a free exchange instead of a return.

## Self-ship returns
If your pincode is not serviceable for pickup, you can ship the item to our returns centre yourself within 7 days of raising the return. Send us the courier receipt and we will reimburse your shipping cost up to ₹150 as ShopNest Wallet balance.

## Quality check and refund
Returned items are inspected within 2 business days of reaching our warehouse. Once the item passes the quality check, the refund is initiated to your original payment method. UPI refunds take 1–3 business days, net banking 3–5 business days and credit or debit card refunds 5–7 business days after initiation.

# Exchanges
## Which items can be exchanged
Apparel and footwear can be exchanged for a different size or colour of the same product within 30 days of delivery. Exchanges are free: there is no pickup fee and no delivery fee. The new size or colour must be available at the same price; if it costs more or less, please return the item and place a new order instead.

query: How many NestCoins do I earn when I shop?
context:
# NestCoins and ShopNest Plus
## Earning NestCoins
NestCoins are ShopNest's loyalty points. You earn 1 NestCoin for every ₹100 you spend on products, calculated on the price you pay after discounts. ShopNest Plus members earn 2 NestCoins for every ₹100. Shipping fees, the Cash on Delivery handling fee and gift card purchases do not earn NestCoins.

NestCoins are credited once the return window for the item closes: 10 days after delivery for electronics and 30 days after delivery for all other items. You can see pending NestCoins under My Account > NestCoins.

## Using NestCoins
1 NestCoin is worth ₹1. You can redeem NestCoins once you have at least 100, and you can pay up to 25% of an order's value with NestCoins. NestCoins can be combined with one other payment method. They cannot be used to buy gift cards.

NestCoins expire 12 months after the date they are credited. NestCoins cannot be transferred to another account or exchanged for cash.

# NestCoins and ShopNest Plus
## NestCoins on returns and cancellations
If you return or cancel an item, the NestCoins you would have earned on it are cancelled. NestCoins you used to pay for it are returned to your balance with their original expiry date; if they would expire within 30 days, we extend them by 30 days.

## ShopNest Plus membership
ShopNest Plus costs ₹999 per year or ₹129 per month. Members get:

- Free standard shipping on every order, with no minimum order value
- Free next-day express delivery, and same-day delivery for ₹49
- Free return pickup, with no ₹79 reverse-pickup fee on change-of-mind returns
- 2 NestCoins for every ₹100 spent, instead of 1
- Early access to the Big Nest Sale, 24 hours before everyone else

## Cancelling Plus
You can cancel ShopNest Plus at any time from My Account > Membership. The annual plan is refunded in full if you cancel within 14 days and have not used any Plus benefit. Otherwise your benefits continue until the end of the paid period, and there is no partial refund. Monthly plans can be cancelled before the next renewal date.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this programme at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Gift Cards
## Buying a gift card
ShopNest e-gift cards are available in any amount from ₹500 to ₹50,000, in multiples of ₹100. The gift card is sent by e-mail or SMS to the recipient within 15 minutes of payment, or on a date you choose when you schedule delivery.

Gift cards can be paid for with UPI, cards or net banking. They cannot be bought with another gift card, NestCoins, ShopNest Wallet balance, Cash on Delivery or EMI. Gift card purchases do not earn NestCoins.

## Validity
Each gift card is valid for 12 months from the date it is issued. The validity cannot be extended. Any balance left after the expiry date is lost, so check your balance under My Account > Gift Cards.

## Using gift cards
You can use up to 5 gift cards on a single order. Gift cards can be combined with one other payment method, such as UPI or a card, to pay the remaining amount. If the order costs less than the gift card balance, the rest stays on the card for future orders.

Gift cards can be used on any product sold on ShopNest, but not to buy other gift cards.

# Big Nest Sale: Terms and Conditions
## Lightning deals
Lightning deals are available in limited quantities for a limited time. You can buy at most 2 units of each lightning deal. The deal price applies only while the deal timer is running and stock lasts; adding an item to your cart does not reserve it.

## Returns during the sale
Our standard return windows apply to sale purchases: 30 days from delivery for most items and 10 days for electronics. Items marked "Final Sale" cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged, defective or wrong.

## Price match during the sale
Neither Price Drop Protection nor Competitor Price Match applies to orders placed during a Big Nest Sale.

## Delivery during the sale
Because of high order volumes, deliveries may take 2–3 business days longer than usual during the sale. Express delivery slots are limited and may sell out.

## NestCoins during the sale
During the sale, all customers earn 2 NestCoins for every ₹100 spent, and ShopNest Plus members earn 3 NestCoins for every ₹100.

# Account and Security
## Deleting your account
You can delete your account from My Account > Privacy > Delete account. Deletion is completed within 30 days of your request. Before you delete it:

- All orders must be delivered and all returns and refunds completed.
- Your NestCoins are forfeited and cannot be restored.
- Your ShopNest Wallet balance is refunded to your bank account.
- Order and invoice records are kept for 8 years, as required by tax law, even after deletion.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Big Nest Sale: Terms and Conditions
## Sale dates
The Big Nest Sale runs twice a year. The Diwali edition runs from 16 to 22 October 2026, and the New Year edition from 26 to 31 December 2026. ShopNest Plus members get early access 24 hours before the sale opens to everyone.

## Bank offer
During the sale, you get a 10% instant discount, up to ₹1,500, when you pay with a partner bank's credit card or credit card EMI on orders of ₹5,000 or more. Each card can use the offer at most 2 times during a sale. The bank offer does not apply to UPI, debit cards, net banking, Cash on Delivery or gift card purchases.

If you return part of an order that used the bank offer and the value of the items you keep falls below ₹5,000, the bank discount is recovered from your refund. If you cancel or return the whole order, you are refunded the amount you actually paid.

# Price Match and Price Drop Protection
## How to request a price match
Before buying, start a chat with ShopNest support and share a link or screenshot of the competitor's offer. If it qualifies, we give you a single-use coupon for the difference, valid for 24 hours.

If you have already bought the item, you can request a price match within 48 hours of your order. The difference is credited to your ShopNest Wallet within 24 hours of approval.

## Limits
The maximum price-match difference is ₹10,000 per item. Each customer can make up to 3 price-match requests per calendar month. ShopNest may refuse a price match if the competitor's stock is very limited or the price appears to be an error.

## Sales
Neither Price Drop Protection nor Competitor Price Match applies to orders placed during a Big Nest Sale.

For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Payment Methods
## Combining payment methods
You can split a payment between ShopNest Wallet balance, gift cards and NestCoins, and one other payment method such as UPI or a card. You cannot split a payment between two cards or between a card and UPI.

## Failed payments
If money was debited but your order was not confirmed, the amount is reversed automatically. UPI debits are reversed within 48 hours. Card and net banking debits are reversed within 5–7 business days, depending on your bank. You do not need to contact us; you can place the order again at any time.

If a payment fails repeatedly, try another method or clear your browser cache. Do not share screenshots of card details with anyone claiming to help with a failed payment.

## Invoices
A GST invoice is generated for every order when it ships. Download it from My Orders > Order details > Download invoice. Business customers who need GST input tax credit must add their GSTIN before placing the order; see the ShopNest Business policy.

# Warranty on Electronics
## Brand warranty
Most electronics sold on ShopNest come with the manufacturer's (brand) warranty, usually 1 year for phones, laptops, tablets and audio devices, and 1–2 years for televisions and appliances. The warranty period is listed on each product page. Your ShopNest invoice is your proof of purchase, so please keep it; you can download it again any time from My Orders.

Brand warranty claims are handled by the brand's authorised service centres. ShopNest support can help you find the nearest service centre, but the repair decision is made by the brand.

## Nestra warranty
Electronics sold under ShopNest's own brand, Nestra, carry a 1-year ShopNest warranty against manufacturing defects. For Nestra products, ShopNest arranges a free pickup, and the item is repaired or replaced within 10–15 business days. If the item cannot be repaired, we replace it or refund the invoice value.

Nestra batteries are covered for 6 months from delivery.

## ShopNest Care extended warranty
ShopNest Care extends the warranty on electronics priced ₹2,000 and above. It must be bought within 30 days of delivery of the product.

# Warranty on Electronics
## Dead on arrival or defective within 10 days
If an electronics item does not work when you first use it, or develops a defect within 10 days of delivery, you do not need to go through warranty. Apparel and footwear can be exchanged for a different size or colour of the same product within 30 days of delivery. Exchanges are free: there is no pickup fee and no delivery fee. Each item can be exchanged only once. If the replacement size or colour does not fit either, you can still return it for a refund.

Electronics cannot be exchanged for a different model, brand or colour. If an electronics item is defective or damaged, it can be replaced with the same model within 10 days of delivery through the returns flow.

Home goods, including furniture, kitchenware, bedding and home decor, are not eligible for exchange. You can return them within 30 days of delivery and place a new order for the item you want.

## How exchanges work

## Return windows
ShopNest accepts returns on most items within 30 days of delivery. This 30-day window applies to apparel, footwear, home goods, kitchenware, bedding, home decor and furniture.

Electronics have a shorter return window of 10 days from delivery. Electronics include mobile phones, laptops, tablets, televisions, cameras, audio devices, wearables, computer accessories and all home appliances. Large appliances such as refrigerators, washing machines and air conditioners can be returned within 10 days only if a ShopNest technician confirms a defect during installation or a service visit.

The return window is counted from the delivery date shown in your order details, not from the order date.

## Conditions for a return
Items must be unused, in their original packaging, with all tags, labels, manuals, accessories and free gifts included. Apparel and footwear must not be washed, altered or worn outdoors.

For phones, laptops and tablets, please sign out of all accounts, remove any screen lock or device lock and perform a factory reset before pickup. A device that is still locked to your account cannot be accepted and will be shipped back to you.

# Returns Policy
## Quality check and refund (continued)
If an item fails the quality check (for example it is used, damaged by the customer or missing accessories), it is shipped back to you at no cost and no refund is issued.

## Gifts
If you received an item as a gift, you can return it within the same window. The refund is issued to your ShopNest Wallet instead of the buyer's payment method, and the buyer is not notified.

- Items marked "Final Sale" during a Big Nest Sale

Go to My Orders, select the item and tap Return. Choose a reason and a pickup slot. Pickup is usually scheduled within 2 business days. Keep the item packed and ready, and hand it over only to the ShopNest courier partner, who will share a pickup OTP.

You can return some items from an order and keep the rest. Each item is handled as a separate return request.

For electronics priced ₹10,000 and above, an unboxing video is also required. The video must be continuous, start with the sealed package showing the shipping label, and show the product being taken out and switched on.

## What we do
For damaged, defective or wrong items, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund. The pickup is free, and the refund includes the shipping fee and the ₹40 Cash on Delivery handling fee, if you paid them. Refunds for damaged or wrong items are initiated as soon as the pickup is completed.

Refunds reach UPI accounts in 1–3 business days, net banking in 3–5 business days and credit or debit cards in 5–7 business days after initiation. ShopNest Wallet refunds arrive within 2 hours.

## Brand warranty
Most electronics sold on ShopNest come with the manufacturer's (brand) warranty, usually 1 year for phones, laptops, tablets and audio devices, and 1–2 years for televisions and appliances. The warranty period is listed on each product page. Your ShopNest invoice is your proof of purchase, so please keep it; you can download it again any time from My Orders.

Brand warranty claims are handled by the brand's authorised service centres. ShopNest support can help you find the nearest service centre, but the repair decision is made by the brand.

Electronics sold under ShopNest's own brand, Nestra, carry a 1-year ShopNest warranty against manufacturing defects. ## Return windows
ShopNest accepts returns on most items within 30 days of delivery. This 30-day window applies to apparel, footwear, home goods, kitchenware, bedding, home decor and furniture.

# Big Nest Sale: Terms and Conditions
## Sale dates
The Big Nest Sale runs twice a year. The Diwali edition runs from 16 to 22 October 2026, and the New Year edition from 26 to 31 December 2026. ShopNest Plus members get early access 24 hours before the sale opens to everyone.

## Bank offer
During the sale, you get a 10% instant discount, up to ₹1,500, when you pay with a partner bank's credit card or credit card EMI on orders of ₹5,000 or more. If you return part of an order that used the bank offer and the value of the items you keep falls below ₹5,000, the bank discount is recovered from your refund. If you cancel or return the whole order, you are refunded the amount you actually paid.

# NestCoins and ShopNest Plus
## Earning NestCoins
NestCoins are ShopNest's loyalty points. You earn 1 NestCoin for every ₹100 you spend on products, calculated on the price you pay after discounts. ShopNest Plus members earn 2 NestCoins for every ₹100. Shipping fees, the Cash on Delivery handling fee and gift card purchases do not earn NestCoins.

NestCoins are credited once the return window for the item closes: 10 days after delivery for electronics and 30 days after delivery for all other items. You can see pending NestCoins under My Account > NestCoins.

## Using NestCoins
1 NestCoin is worth ₹1. You can redeem NestCoins once you have at least 100, and you can pay up to 25% of an order's value with NestCoins. NestCoins can be combined with one other payment method. They cannot be used to buy gift cards.

NestCoins expire 12 months after the date they are credited. NestCoins cannot be transferred to another account or exchanged for cash.

# NestCoins and ShopNest Plus
## NestCoins on returns and cancellations
If you return or cancel an item, the NestCoins you would have earned on it are cancelled. NestCoins you used to pay for it are returned to your balance with their original expiry date; if they would expire within 30 days, we extend them by 30 days.

## ShopNest Plus membership
ShopNest Plus costs ₹999 per year or ₹129 per month. Members get:

- Free standard shipping on every order, with no minimum order value

If you see an order you did not place, or a change you did not make, report it within 24 hours through chat or by calling 1800-202-6378. We freeze the account within 1 hour of your report and complete the investigation within 7 business days. Any amount charged for a confirmed unauthorised order is refunded in full.

You can sign out of all devices at any time from My Account > Security > Sign out everywhere.

# Contact Us and Escalation
## Escalation levels (continued)
1. **Level 1, Customer Support:** chat, phone or e-mail. Most issues are resolved here.
2. **Level 2, Customer Care Manager:** if your issue is not resolved within 48 hours, ask the agent to escalate it, or tap "Escalate" on your ticket. A Customer Care Manager responds within 1 business day and aims to resolve the issue within 3 business days.
3. **Level 3, Grievance Officer:** if you are still not satisfied, write to grievance@shopnest.example with your ticket number. The Grievance Officer acknowledges your complaint within 48 hours and resolves it within 30 days, as required by the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.

If your complaint is still unresolved after these steps, you can contact the National Consumer Helpline by calling 1915.

# Account and Security
## Deleting your account
You can delete your account from My Account > Privacy > Delete account. Deletion is completed within 30 days of your request. Before you delete it:

- All orders must be delivered and all returns and refunds completed.
- Your NestCoins are forfeited and cannot be restored.
- Your ShopNest Wallet balance is refunded to your bank account.
- Order and invoice records are kept for 8 years, as required by tax law, even after deletion.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Refunds
## When a refund is initiated
For returns, the refund is initiated after the returned item passes our quality check, which happens within 2 business days of the item reaching our warehouse. For prepaid orders that you cancel before they are shipped, the refund is initiated immediately. For damaged, defective or wrong items, the refund is initiated as soon as the pickup is completed.

You will receive an SMS and e-mail with the refund amount and a refund reference number. For card and net banking refunds this reference is the ARN (Acquirer Reference Number), which your bank can use to trace the credit.

## Refund timelines by payment method
Once a refund is initiated, the time it takes to reach you depends on how you paid:

| Payment method | Refund timeline after initiation |
|---|---|
| UPI | 1–3 business days |
| Net banking | 3–5 business days |
| Credit or debit card | 5–7 business days |
| Card EMI | 7–10 business days |
| International card | 7–14 business days |
| ShopNest Wallet | within 2 hours |
| Gift card | within 24 hours, back to the same gift card |
| Cash on Delivery | ShopNest Wallet within 2 hours, or bank account via NEFT in 5–7 business days |

# Cash on Delivery and EMI
## EMI on cancellations and returns
If you cancel or return an order paid by card EMI, the refund goes back to your card and your bank cancels the EMI plan. Card EMI refunds take 7–10 business days after the refund is initiated. Interest already charged by your bank for the months that have passed, and any processing fee, are governed by your bank's policy and are not refunded by ShopNest.

EMI is not available on gift card purchases or international orders.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

- Phone: 1800-202-6378 (toll-free), 8 AM to 10 PM IST, every day including Sundays and public holidays.

Support is available in English, Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi and Bengali. Choose your language at the start of the chat or call.

You can also request a callback from the Help page. During phone support hours, we call back within 2 hours.

## Your ticket number
Every request gets a ticket number in the format SN- followed by 8 digits, for example SN-20461183. Keep this number; it lets any agent see the full history of your request, so you do not need to explain it again.

If your issue is not resolved, you can escalate it in three steps:

# Exchanges

context:
# Domestic Shipping
## Delayed or lost shipments
If your order has not arrived within 3 business days after the promised delivery date, contact support. We investigate delayed shipments within 48 hours. If a shipment is confirmed lost in transit, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund, including any shipping fee.

## Faster options
Need it sooner? Express next-day and same-day delivery are available in selected cities. See the Express Delivery policy for cities, cut-off times and fees.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Express Delivery
## Next-day delivery
Next-day delivery is available in 25 cities, including Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Kochi, Lucknow and Indore. Place your order by 12 noon to receive it the next day.

Next-day delivery costs ₹99 per order. It is free for ShopNest Plus members.

## Same-day delivery
Same-day delivery is available in 6 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai, Delhi NCR, Hyderabad, Chennai and Pune. Place your order by 10 AM to receive it the same evening, by 9 PM.

Same-day delivery costs ₹149 per order. ShopNest Plus members pay ₹49 for same-day delivery.

In these 6 cities, express deliveries also run on Sundays. In the other next-day cities, an order placed on Saturday is delivered on Monday.

## Eligible items
Express delivery is available only on items marked "Express eligible" on the product page. Furniture, large appliances and orders shipping outside India cannot be sent by express. If your cart has both eligible and non-eligible items, the order is split and only the eligible items are sent by express.

# Express Delivery
## Eligible items (continued)
Cash on Delivery is available on express orders up to ₹10,000. Express orders above ₹10,000 must be prepaid.

## If we miss the express promise
If an express order arrives later than promised, the express fee is refunded automatically to your ShopNest Wallet within 48 hours. You do not need to contact us. The express fee is not refunded if the delay was caused by an incorrect address or because nobody was available to receive the package.

## Cancelling an express order
Express orders can be cancelled free of charge before they are shipped, like any other order. Express orders are often dispatched within an hour, so the cancellation window can be very short. If an express order is cancelled before dispatch, the express fee is refunded along with the order amount.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Order Changes and Cancellation
## Refunds for cancelled orders
For prepaid orders cancelled before dispatch, the refund is initiated immediately. Refunds to UPI take 1–3 business days, net banking 3–5 business days and credit or debit cards 5–7 business days. Refunds to the ShopNest Wallet arrive within 2 hours. The shipping fee is refunded in full when an order is cancelled before dispatch.

## Coupons on cancelled orders
If you cancel an order before dispatch, any single-use coupon used on the order is restored to your account, provided the coupon has not expired. Bank offer discounts are not restored; you can use the offer again only if it is still running.

## Changing the delivery address
The delivery address can be changed before the order is shipped, but only to another address with the same pincode. To deliver to a different pincode, cancel the order and place a new one. The phone number for delivery can be changed until the order is out for delivery.

# Order Changes and Cancellation
## Cancelling an order
You can cancel an order free of charge at any time before it is shipped. Go to My Orders, select the order and tap Cancel. You can cancel the whole order or only some items from it. Orders with the status "Order placed" or "Packed" can still be cancelled; once the status changes to "Shipped", the order can no longer be cancelled online.

Personalised or engraved products can be cancelled only within 6 hours of placing the order, because production starts soon after.

## After the order has shipped
Once an order has shipped, it cannot be cancelled. You can either refuse the delivery at the doorstep or accept it and request a return within the return window.

If you refuse a prepaid order at the doorstep, the refund is initiated after the package returns to our warehouse, which usually takes up to 7 days. If you refuse a Cash on Delivery order, nothing is charged. Note that if 3 Cash on Delivery orders are refused within 6 months, Cash on Delivery may be disabled for your account.

# Damaged, Defective, Missing or Wrong Items
## Wrong item delivered
If you received a different product, size or colour from the one you ordered, please do not use it or remove its tags. We will pick it up and ship the correct item within 3–5 business days. If the correct item is out of stock, you receive a full refund.

## Missing items or accessories
If an item or an accessory is missing, report it within 48 hours of delivery. Before you report it, check whether your order was split into several shipments; My Orders shows each shipment separately. We review missing-item reports within 2 business days, and then ship the missing item or refund it.

## Damaged packaging at delivery
If the outer box is visibly damaged, torn or wet when the courier arrives, you can refuse the delivery, or accept it and ask the courier to note the damage on their device. Either way, please report it to us within 48 hours with photos.

# Order Changes and Cancellation
## Changing items, size or quantity
Items, sizes, colours and quantities cannot be changed after an order is placed. Cancel the item before it ships and place a new order. If the item has already been delivered, apparel and footwear can be exchanged for a different size or colour within 30 days.

## Rescheduling large-item deliveries
For furniture and large appliances, you can reschedule the delivery slot up to 2 times at no cost from My Orders.

## Cancellations by ShopNest
In rare cases, ShopNest may cancel an order, for example because of a pricing error, an item going out of stock or a failed address verification. You will be informed by SMS and e-mail and receive a full refund, including any shipping fee.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# ShopNest Business: Bulk and B2B Orders
## Payment and credit terms
Business orders can be paid by NEFT, RTGS, corporate card or UPI. Verified businesses can apply for net-30 credit terms after 3 successful orders, with a credit limit of up to ₹5,00,000.

## Delivery
Bulk orders are delivered within 7–12 business days. Delivery to several office locations is available for ₹999 per additional address.

## Cancellation
A confirmed bulk order can be cancelled free of charge within 24 hours of confirmation. After 24 hours, a cancellation fee of 5% of the order value applies if the order has not shipped. Bulk orders cannot be cancelled once they have shipped.

## Returns on bulk orders
Change-of-mind returns are not accepted on bulk orders. Damaged, defective, missing or wrong items in a bulk order must be reported within 7 days of delivery, instead of the 48 hours that applies to regular orders, because large deliveries take longer to inspect. We replace or refund the affected units only.

query: Quick question: As a Plus member, how many NestCoins do I earn on a ₹20,000 phone in the Diwali sale, and when are they credited?
context:
# Big Nest Sale: Terms and Conditions
## Sale dates
The Big Nest Sale runs twice a year. The Diwali edition runs from 16 to 22 October 2026, and the New Year edition from 26 to 31 December 2026. ShopNest Plus members get early access 24 hours before the sale opens to everyone.

## Bank offer
During the sale, you get a 10% instant discount, up to ₹1,500, when you pay with a partner bank's credit card or credit card EMI on orders of ₹5,000 or more. Each card can use the offer at most 2 times during a sale. The bank offer does not apply to UPI, debit cards, net banking, Cash on Delivery or gift card purchases.

If you return part of an order that used the bank offer and the value of the items you keep falls below ₹5,000, the bank discount is recovered from your refund. If you cancel or return the whole order, you are refunded the amount you actually paid.

# NestCoins and ShopNest Plus
## Earning NestCoins
NestCoins are ShopNest's loyalty points. You earn 1 NestCoin for every ₹100 you spend on products, calculated on the price you pay after discounts. ShopNest Plus members earn 2 NestCoins for every ₹100. Shipping fees, the Cash on Delivery handling fee and gift card purchases do not earn NestCoins.

NestCoins are credited once the return window for the item closes: 10 days after delivery for electronics and 30 days after delivery for all other items. You can see pending NestCoins under My Account > NestCoins.

## Using NestCoins
1 NestCoin is worth ₹1. You can redeem NestCoins once you have at least 100, and you can pay up to 25% of an order's value with NestCoins. NestCoins can be combined with one other payment method. They cannot be used to buy gift cards.

NestCoins expire 12 months after the date they are credited. NestCoins cannot be transferred to another account or exchanged for cash.

# NestCoins and ShopNest Plus
## NestCoins on returns and cancellations
If you return or cancel an item, the NestCoins you would have earned on it are cancelled. NestCoins you used to pay for it are returned to your balance with their original expiry date; if they would expire within 30 days, we extend them by 30 days.

## ShopNest Plus membership
ShopNest Plus costs ₹999 per year or ₹129 per month. Members get:

- Free standard shipping on every order, with no minimum order value
- Free next-day express delivery, and same-day delivery for ₹49
- Free return pickup, with no ₹79 reverse-pickup fee on change-of-mind returns
- 2 NestCoins for every ₹100 spent, instead of 1
- Early access to the Big Nest Sale, 24 hours before everyone else

## Cancelling Plus
You can cancel ShopNest Plus at any time from My Account > Membership. The annual plan is refunded in full if you cancel within 14 days and have not used any Plus benefit. Otherwise your benefits continue until the end of the paid period, and there is no partial refund. Monthly plans can be cancelled before the next renewal date.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this programme at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Big Nest Sale: Terms and Conditions
## Lightning deals
Lightning deals are available in limited quantities for a limited time. You can buy at most 2 units of each lightning deal. The deal price applies only while the deal timer is running and stock lasts; adding an item to your cart does not reserve it.

## Returns during the sale
Our standard return windows apply to sale purchases: 30 days from delivery for most items and 10 days for electronics. Items marked "Final Sale" cannot be returned unless they arrive damaged, defective or wrong.

## Price match during the sale
Neither Price Drop Protection nor Competitor Price Match applies to orders placed during a Big Nest Sale.

## Delivery during the sale
Because of high order volumes, deliveries may take 2–3 business days longer than usual during the sale. Express delivery slots are limited and may sell out.

## NestCoins during the sale
During the sale, all customers earn 2 NestCoins for every ₹100 spent, and ShopNest Plus members earn 3 NestCoins for every ₹100.

# Gift Cards
## Buying a gift card
ShopNest e-gift cards are available in any amount from ₹500 to ₹50,000, in multiples of ₹100. The gift card is sent by e-mail or SMS to the recipient within 15 minutes of payment, or on a date you choose when you schedule delivery.

Gift cards can be paid for with UPI, cards or net banking. They cannot be bought with another gift card, NestCoins, ShopNest Wallet balance, Cash on Delivery or EMI. Gift card purchases do not earn NestCoins.

## Validity
Each gift card is valid for 12 months from the date it is issued. The validity cannot be extended. Any balance left after the expiry date is lost, so check your balance under My Account > Gift Cards.

## Using gift cards
You can use up to 5 gift cards on a single order. Gift cards can be combined with one other payment method, such as UPI or a card, to pay the remaining amount. If the order costs less than the gift card balance, the rest stays on the card for future orders.

Gift cards can be used on any product sold on ShopNest, but not to buy other gift cards.

# Payment Methods
## Accepted payment methods
ShopNest accepts the following payment methods on orders delivered within India:

- UPI, using any UPI app, a UPI ID or a QR code
- Credit and debit cards: Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, American Express and Diners Club
- Net banking from more than 50 banks
- ShopNest Wallet balance
- ShopNest gift cards
- NestCoins (1 NestCoin = ₹1)
- EMI on credit cards, select debit cards and cardless EMI
- Cash on Delivery (COD)

All prices are in Indian rupees (INR) and include GST.

## UPI
UPI payments are confirmed instantly. The maximum amount per UPI transaction is set by your bank, usually ₹1,00,000. ShopNest Plus membership can be renewed automatically using UPI AutoPay.

## Cards
Saved cards are stored as secure tokens in line with RBI card-tokenisation rules. ShopNest never stores your full card number or your CVV. Every card payment is authenticated with an OTP or your bank's 3D Secure page. International cards are accepted, and are charged in Indian rupees; your bank may add a foreign-exchange fee.

# Price Match and Price Drop Protection
## How to request a price match
Before buying, start a chat with ShopNest support and share a link or screenshot of the competitor's offer. If it qualifies, we give you a single-use coupon for the difference, valid for 24 hours.

If you have already bought the item, you can request a price match within 48 hours of your order. The difference is credited to your ShopNest Wallet within 24 hours of approval.

## Limits
The maximum price-match difference is ₹10,000 per item. Each customer can make up to 3 price-match requests per calendar month. ShopNest may refuse a price match if the competitor's stock is very limited or the price appears to be an error.

## Sales
Neither Price Drop Protection nor Competitor Price Match applies to orders placed during a Big Nest Sale.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. ShopNest reserves the right to modify this policy at any time without prior notice. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# ShopNest Business: Bulk and B2B Orders
## Corporate gift cards
Companies buying ShopNest gift cards get a 2% discount on gift card orders of ₹1,00,000 or more, and a 4% discount on orders of ₹5,00,000 or more. Corporate gift cards follow the standard gift card terms, including 12 months' validity.

## Need more help?
For more information, e-mail business@shopnest.example or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for choosing ShopNest Business. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

query: Could you tell me: My account got locked. How long until I can try again?
context:
# Account and Security
## Signing in
You can sign in to ShopNest with a one-time password (OTP) sent to your mobile number, or with your e-mail address and password. We recommend turning on 2-step verification under My Account > Security, so that a new device needs both your password and an OTP.

Each mobile number can be linked to only one ShopNest account.

## Locked accounts
After 5 failed sign-in attempts, your account is locked for 30 minutes to protect it. You can wait 30 minutes and try again, or reset your password straight away using the "Forgot password" link, which sends a reset link to your registered e-mail address. The reset link is valid for 24 hours.

## Changing your mobile number
To change the mobile number on your account, go to My Account > Profile > Mobile number. We send an OTP to both your old and your new number. If you no longer have access to the old number, choose "I don't have my old number" and we will verify you through a link sent to your registered e-mail address, valid for 24 hours.

# Account and Security
## Staying safe
Important: ShopNest will never ask for your OTP, password, CVV, UPI PIN or full card number over phone, e-mail, SMS or chat. Our agents will never ask you to install a screen-sharing or remote-access app. If someone asks for these details claiming to be from ShopNest, do not share them and report it to security@shopnest.example.

Beware of fake ShopNest pages and messages offering prizes, refunds or jobs in exchange for a payment or your bank details. ShopNest never asks you to pay money to receive a refund.

## Unauthorised activity
If you see an order you did not place, or a change you did not make, report it within 24 hours through chat or by calling 1800-202-6378. We freeze the account within 1 hour of your report and complete the investigation within 7 business days. Any amount charged for a confirmed unauthorised order is refunded in full.

You can sign out of all devices at any time from My Account > Security > Sign out everywhere.

# Account and Security
## Deleting your account
You can delete your account from My Account > Privacy > Delete account. Deletion is completed within 30 days of your request. Before you delete it:

- All orders must be delivered and all returns and refunds completed.
- Your NestCoins are forfeited and cannot be restored.
- Your ShopNest Wallet balance is refunded to your bank account.
- Order and invoice records are kept for 8 years, as required by tax law, even after deletion.

## Need more help?
For more information, visit the ShopNest Help Centre or reach our support team on 24x7 chat. We value your business and thank you for shopping with ShopNest. Last updated: 1 August 2026.

# Contact Us and Escalation
## Escalation levels (continued)
1. **Level 1, Customer Support:** chat, phone or e-mail. Most issues are resolved here.
2. **Level 2, Customer Care Manager:** if your issue is not resolved within 48 hours, ask the agent to escalate it, or tap "Escalate" on your ticket. A Customer Care Manager responds within 1 business day and aims to resolve the issue within 3 business days.
3. **Level 3, Grievance Officer:** if you are still not satisfied, write to grievance@shopnest.example with your ticket number. The Grievance Officer acknowledges your complaint within 48 hours and resolves it within 30 days, as required by the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020.

If your complaint is still unresolved after these steps, you can contact the National Consumer Helpline by calling 1915.

# Refunds
## When a refund is initiated
For returns, the refund is initiated after the returned item passes our quality check, which happens within 2 business days of the item reaching our warehouse. For prepaid orders that you cancel before they are shipped, the refund is initiated immediately. For damaged, defective or wrong items, the refund is initiated as soon as the pickup is completed.

# Returns Policy
## Return pickup fees
Return pickup is free when an item is damaged, defective or wrong. For change-of-mind returns (for example "no longer needed" or "found a better price"), a reverse-pickup fee of ₹79 is deducted from your refund. ShopNest Plus members never pay the reverse-pickup fee. Size and fit issues on apparel and footwear are best handled as a free exchange instead of a return.

## Self-ship returns
If your pincode is not serviceable for pickup, you can ship the item to our returns centre yourself within 7 days of raising the return. Send us the courier receipt and we will reimburse your shipping cost up to ₹150 as ShopNest Wallet balance.

## Quality check and refund
Returned items are inspected within 2 business days of reaching our warehouse. Once the item passes the quality check, the refund is initiated to your original payment method. UPI refunds take 1–3 business days, net banking 3–5 business days and credit or debit card refunds 5–7 business days after initiation.

# Refunds
## What is refunded (continued)
- The shipping fee is refunded only if the order is cancelled before dispatch, or if the item was damaged, defective or wrong.
- The ₹40 Cash on Delivery handling fee is not refunded, except when the item was damaged, defective or wrong.
- For change-of-mind returns, the ₹79 reverse-pickup fee is deducted from the refund (waived for ShopNest Plus members).
- NestCoins used on the order are returned to your NestCoins balance, not paid out as money.
- If a bank offer discount was applied, you are refunded the amount you actually paid, not the pre-discount price.

## Refund not received?
Refund timelines for UPI are 1–3 business days, for net banking 3–5 business days and for cards 5–7 business days after the refund is initiated. If the refund has not reached you after this time, first check with your bank using the refund reference number. If the bank cannot find it, contact ShopNest support with your order ID and refund reference number and we will investigate within 48 hours.

# Exchanges
## Which items can be exchanged
Apparel and footwear can be exchanged for a different size or colour of the same product within 30 days of delivery. Exchanges are free: there is no pickup fee and no delivery fee. The new size or colour must be available at the same price; if it costs more or less, please return the item and place a new order instead.

Each item can be exchanged only once. If the replacement size or colour does not fit either, you can still return it for a refund.

Electronics cannot be exchanged for a different model, brand or colour. If an electronics item is defective or damaged, it can be replaced with the same model within 10 days of delivery through the returns flow.

Home goods, including furniture, kitchenware, bedding and home decor, are not eligible for exchange. You can return them within 30 days of delivery and place a new order for the item you want.

## NestCoins on returns and cancellations
If you return or cancel an item, the NestCoins you would have earned on it are cancelled. NestCoins you used to pay for it are returned to your balance with their original expiry date; if they would expire within 30 days, we extend them by 30 days.

## ShopNest Plus membership
ShopNest Plus costs ₹999 per year or ₹129 per month. Members get:

- Free standard shipping on every order, with no minimum order value

- Free return pickup, with no ₹79 reverse-pickup fee on change-of-mind returns
